campaign_exclusive_types._method: Verified 2026-09-14 by reading site-oracle/site-engine.mjs directly (not guessed from names): for each type, searched for its spawn/creation call sites (putBoardPiece/type assignment/applyCardEffect switch case) and checked whether every such site is reachable only from campaign-gated code (createCampaignBoard, setupJanggiSide which is only invoked for the janggi CAMPAIGN_DEFS entry, applyCampaignChameleons/CHAMELEON_AUCTION_TYPES which is a campaign shop minigame, or the Blood Moon/vampireLord-precondition mechanic). A type is excluded from this list if ANY normal-play (non-campaign) card in applyCardEffect spawns it, even if it ALSO appears in a campaign-only path.

types.alfil: only appears in CHAMELEON_AUCTION_TYPES (site-engine.mjs ~36745/36777), which is consumed exclusively by applyCampaignChameleons() (a campaign shop/auction minigame). No applyCardEffect case spawns it.
types.camel: spawned only via CHAMELEON_AUCTION_TYPES (campaign auction) and setupJanggiSide() (janggi is a CAMPAIGN_DEFS entry, ~line 36619-36627). No normal card.
types.fanatic: only appears in CHAMELEON_AUCTION_TYPES (campaign auction, incl. a 'suicide-fanatic' auction lot). No applyCardEffect case; the real 'fanatical-ritual'(광신적 의식) MIDDLE card does NOT spawn a fanatic-type piece (checked: no base$N('fanatic',...) catalog entry either).
types.merchant: only appears in CHAMELEON_AUCTION_TYPES as a 'royalReplacement' shop purchase ('구매하면 원래 킹을 대체합니다', campaign auction only). No normal card; the real 'merchant-guild'(상인 조합) OPENING card does not spawn this piece type.
types.man: spawned only via setupJanggiSide() (campaign janggi setup, manRow pawn-equivalent) and CHAMELEON_AUCTION_TYPES. No normal card.
types.cardinal: only appears in CHAMELEON_AUCTION_TYPES. No applyCardEffect case, no base$N('cardinal',...) catalog entry.
types.royalKnight: only appears in CHAMELEON_AUCTION_TYPES as a 'royalReplacement' shop purchase (campaign auction). No normal card spawns it (only referenced elsewhere in generic royal-identity/king-type exclusion lists, which is defensive code, not a spawn path).
types.coffin: only used as part of the Blood Moon / vampireLord mechanic (BLOOD_MOON_EFFECT_CARDS.coffin, resurrection-at-coffin logic ~line 84477/84631) which requires a vampireLord piece (itself campaign-only, see below) as a precondition; matches the already-known bloodCard campaign/vampireLord-precondition exclusion from the 2026-09-13 self-play card-pool investigation. Elsewhere it only appears in generic terrain/obstacle exclusion lists (defensive code, not a spawn path).
types.timeTraveler: spawned only inside createCampaignBoard() (~line 49915, a specific campaign stage setup). No normal card.
types.vampireLord: spawned only inside createCampaignBoard() (~line 49919). No normal card; ROYAL_PIECE_TYPES/royal-identity references elsewhere are defensive exclusion code, not spawn paths.
types.bat: spawned only inside createCampaignBoard() (~lines 49920-49921, two bats placed as part of a specific campaign stage). No normal card.
types.ferz: only appears in CHAMELEON_AUCTION_TYPES (campaign auction). No applyCardEffect case.

confirmed_normal_play_examples._note: Spot-checked counter-examples that show the method distinguishes correctly: types that also appear in campaign-only code paths but ARE legitimately spawnable in normal play, so they are NOT excluded.
confirmed_normal_play_examples.pegasus: has a real PIECE-category card (id 'pegasus', title '유니콘', applyCardEffect case 'pegasus' at ~82496) even though it also appears in CHAMELEON_AUCTION_TYPES as an 'unicorn' auction lot — the normal card path means it is in-scope for the audit.
confirmed_normal_play_examples.squire: spawned by the real 'apprentice-knights'(견습 기사단) OPENING card via apprenticeKnights() (~line 85241), even though it shares pawnMoves() dispatch with standardBearer.
confirmed_normal_play_examples.darkWizard: spawned by the real 'black-magic'(흑마법) END card via blackMagic() (~line 81726), even though it's also grouped with campaign-only royal types (royalKnight, vampireLord, timeTraveler) in defensive royal-identity checks.
confirmed_normal_play_examples.bear: not directly card-spawned, but is the in-game evolution/promotion of babyBear (a real normal-play END card 'baby-bear'/아기곰) after bearRetaliationsRemaining reaches 0 — in scope for the audit as a normal-play piece.
confirmed_normal_play_examples.cannon: CORRECTION (2026-09-14, found during the card audit, not the original piece pass): initially misclassified as campaign-only because the search only looked for `case "cannon":`-style dispatch, which misses cards that assign the type without a same-named case. The real 'eastern-policy'(동방견문록) PIECE card's easternPolicy() function does `item.type = "cannon"` (transforms an own bishop/knight into a cannon) — a genuine normal-play spawn path. cannon is NOT campaign-only; setupJanggiSide() is simply a second, campaign-only spawn path for the same type. This is a reminder that the type-assignment search must also be done for every roster entry, not just the case-label search, before trusting a campaign-only verdict.
